question: On the consumed fresh SceneNN cohort, can RoMa retain whole-image context and restrict cycle evidence to the exact co-visible target masks to recover true-pair support without relaxing any matcher or NONE threshold?

predecessor.failure_signature: Truth-visible crop resizing preserved zero false positives but left TF02 below cycle purity and reduced edge-clipped TF03 reference evidence to a 40-pixel-wide crop.
predecessor.single_change: Run the unchanged RoMa model on each complete 640x480 endpoint image, then compute support only for cycles starting inside the provider target-visible mask and landing inside the paired target-visible mask; keep weights, resolutions, thresholds, assignment, scenarios, targets and gate unchanged.

selected_primary_sources.title: OAMatcher: An Overlapping Areas-based Network for Accurate Local Feature Matching
selected_primary_sources.used_for: Its whole-image message interaction followed by co-visible-area focus motivates preserving RoMa global context before support gating.

selected_primary_sources.title: O-MaMa: Learning Object Mask Matching between Egocentric and Exocentric Views
selected_primary_sources.used_for: Its mask-plus-extended-context evidence motivates retaining target identity evidence without discarding surrounding spatial context.

renderer.near_plane_face_rule: reject unless every vertex is beyond near plane
renderer.visibility_rule: target depth finite and no farther than full-scene depth plus 0.005 m

context_and_support.model_input: Complete sealed 640x480 RGB frame independently resized by the unchanged RoMa implementation.
context_and_support.source_domain: Nearest-neighbour resize of the exact provider target-visible mask to the 864x864 RoMa support grid.
context_and_support.target_domain: A forward match counts only when its sampled target coordinate lies inside the paired resized target-visible mask.
context_and_support.cycle_purity_denominator: All above-certainty source target-visible mask pixels, including those whose forward coordinate misses the target mask.
context_and_support.rank_score: Geometric mean of bilateral target-mask-gated cycle fractions.

matcher.absolute_support: Unchanged bilateral one-percent target-mask cycle fraction and majority cycle purity.
matcher.zero_assignment: Unchanged strict reciprocal maximum among absolutely supported pairs.

forbidden_after_freeze: change full-image input, mask resize, source or target domain, denominator, matcher, threshold, assignment, scenarios or gate
add dilation, erosion, padding, a learned mask, or a context weight after outcome
drop TF02, TF03, any different-target pair, or any failed scenario
claim freshness or confirmation authority from this consumed posthoc replay
claim_boundary: This is consumed posthoc Development evidence for privileged whole-image correspondence with provider target-mask support only. It does not prove raw-phone target proposals, named entrance, venue ownership, access, traversability, approach waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, user benefit, deployment, or safety.
